name: Dream Finders Homes
verdict: DEFER-ON-PACK + RP_TAINTED — no position, minimum-starter does NOT attach (unclean court, 7271.T precedent: the binding variable is a document, not a judgment). Binding unknown: the $450M convertible preferred's certificate of designations (conversion price/seniority/PIK/CoC put) — 33.7% of mcap, terms unpublished. RP_TAINTED (governance): DE->TX reincorporation 90 days before committing $2.2B all-cash w/ no financing condition, then equity-plan FMV 'flexibility' amendment approved by WRITTEN CONSENT at -53% — never RP_FAIR, <=0.85x E[fv] cap permanent if advanced.
conviction: red 8/10 REJECT (two of its FATALs failed audit), blue 7/10 DEFER — adjudicator with blue
kill_class_census: 4 NOVEL (governance forum-shift+consent-FMV; preferred-terms data-kill; land-bank margin-transfer mechanism [magnitude unpriced]; brief's P/B double-count) / 1 CONSENSUS (consensus EPS revision)
audit_notes: XBRL re-verified at adjudication: DFH SE $1,431,903,000 and Beazer SE $1,146,990,000 (data.sec.gov companyconcept) — blue's book-accretion finding is REAL: ~$916M cash for $1,147M of target book, no shares issued -> bargain-purchase/zero-goodwill mechanics; P/B 0.93x, P/TBV 1.27x (red right, brief wrong). Blue overturned red's venue attack (8/18 doc holds the pro-forma structure red said didn't exist) and cut pro-forma leverage 70% -> 64-67%. Blue's B: purchase-accounting inventory step-up will depress reported GAAP GM through 2027 while cash economics are unchanged — the actual gradeable divergence, unlitigated by red.
recourt_triggers: certificate of designations published (resolves the data-kill — data kills are temporary)
bridge takeout priced (<=7.5% senior notes retires the leverage leg)
2026-09-14 Series A redemption ($154.3M = 76% of b/s cash) — liquidity checkpoint

narratives: The cert of designations prints benign, the bargain-purchase gain lands ~$2.54/sh, and the -53% name re-rates on book accretion while we waited for a document that was never going to be ugly.
Housing legs down before close: the 364-day bridge meets a shut HY window and the no-financing-condition obligation forces issuance at distressed terms.
Reflexive: RP_TAINTED caps mean even a perfect re-court enters at 0.85x — we structurally cannot be paid full value for being right here, which biases the file toward permanent avoidance.
premortem.sentence: If this ruling costs us, the most likely reason will be that we priced the governance smell as if it were the balance sheet — and a founder who moved his company to Texas to do a deal cheaply did the deal cheaply for shareholders too.
